<script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "ProfessionalService",
    "name": "SixthVision — Caravan & RV Commercial Production",
    "url": "https://sixthvisioncommercial.com.au",
    "areaServed": ["Melbourne", "Campbellfield", "Somerton", "Victoria", "Australia"],
    "serviceType": ["Caravan Commercial Photography", "RV Launch Videography", "Dealership Media Production"]
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #F7F3EC;
      --surface: #EFE9DE;
      --card: #FCFBF8;
      --hair: #DDD4C6;
      --ink: #1C1917;
      --muted: #5C544B;
      --accent: #9A6B38;
    }
    html, body {
      background-color: var(--bg);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
      overflow-x: clip;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    .font-editorial {
      font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif;
      letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    }
    .hairline-b { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair); }
    .hairline-t { border-top: 1px solid var(--hair); }
    .hairline-all { border: 1px solid var(--hair); }

    /* Cinematic Hero subtle breathing motion */
    @keyframes heroDrift {
      0% { transform: scale(1.01); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.045); }
      100% { transform: scale(1.01); }
    }
    .hero-cinematic-img {
      animation: heroDrift 22s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .hero-cinematic-img { animation: none; }
    }

    /* Scroll Disassembly Stage */
    #disassembly-track { height: 500vh; position: relative; }
    #disassembly-sticky { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
    @media (max-width: 767px), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      #disassembly-track { height: auto; }
      #disassembly-sticky { position: relative; height: auto; }
    }

    .explode-plate {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      will-change: opacity, transform;
      transition: opacity 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    /* SVG Architectural Callout Leader Animation */
    .callout-group {
      transition: opacity 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    @keyframes ringPulse {
      0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.7; }
      100% { transform: scale(2.15); opacity: 0; }
    }
    .hotspot-pulse::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      border: 1.5px solid #9A6B38;
      animation: ringPulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hotspot-pulse::after { animation: none; } }


    /* v1.1: independent-component 2.5D visual storyboard; concept artwork only. */
    #assembly-parts { transition: opacity 180ms linear; isolation:isolate; }
    .component-plate { position:absolute; inset:0; display:block; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:fill;
      will-change:transform; transform-origin:center; backface-visibility:hidden; user-select:none; }
    .piece-roof {clip-path:polygon(30% 19%,37% 10%,51% 8%,61% 13%,77% 14%,79% 24%,74% 29%,54% 27%,31% 26%);z-index:5}
    .piece-nose {clip-path:polygon(8% 39%,25% 37%,24% 45%,22% 51%,22% 72%,15% 75%,8% 72%);z-index:6}
    .piece-cabin {clip-path:polygon(28% 34%,42% 31%,56% 30%,60% 32%,59% 69%,49% 70%,28% 67%);z-index:3}
    .piece-wall {clip-path:polygon(58% 29%,84% 30%,87% 37%,86% 69%,79% 72%,59% 73%);z-index:4}
    .piece-chassis {clip-path:polygon(13% 68%,34% 67%,48% 68%,62% 69%,82% 65%,80% 78%,70% 87%,52% 91%,31% 83%,16% 94%,12% 85%);z-index:2}
    #assembly-parts .component-plate {clip-path:none; filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 8px rgba(45,31,19,.12)); }
    .concept-watermark {position:absolute;z-index:15;left:12px;bottom:12px;padding:7px 10px;background:#1C1917dd;
      color:#fff;font:10px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.04em;}
    .gallery-provenance {border-top:1px solid #DDD4C6;padding:8px 14px;color:#64584a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.03em;background:#fcfbf8}
    #concept-disclosure { margin-top:64px; }
    #top {padding-top:20px;}
    #explode-viewport {min-width:0; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/10;}
    #disassembly .grid > div { min-width:0; }
    @media (min-width:640px) { #explode-viewport {aspect-ratio:16/9;} }
    @media (max-width:520px) {.header-cta{display:none!important}}
    @media (min-width:1024px) { #explode-viewport {max-height:min(66vh,570px);} }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.component-plate {will-change:auto}}
    :target {scroll-margin-top:90px}

    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9A6B38; outline-offset: 2px; }
  </style>
</head>

  <main id="main-content">

      <strong class="font-semibold tracking-wide">CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT DEMO</strong> &nbsp;·&nbsp; 3D/cutaway and lifestyle scenes below are illustrative concept imagery, not verified Billabong photographs or engineering specifications. <a href="#work" class="underline underline-offset-2 text-white hover:text-bronze">View portfolio media options</a>.

    <!-- CINEMATIC QUIET-LUXURY HERO (ZERO OVERLAP · AAA LEGIBILITY · FULL VIEWPORT) -->
    <section id="top" class="pt-20 pb-8 sm:pt-22 sm:pb-10 bg-alabaster hairline-b">

    <!-- 01 / CINEMATIC ULTRA-DETAILED SCROLL DISASSEMBLY -->
